body:

with the scope set in the same exchange:

**Filed by** the PM seat in that session · `os-sales`. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` execution seat, dispatching one cloud dev (`mode:cloud`) that runs `.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md` scoped to the v18 line, then `checklist-test since:v18`. `docs/qa/**` is a `domain:devx` path by the domain table; #9299 and #21932 are the same lane.

## Reading (origin/main `c5cf546`, 2026-10-16)

- `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18 --json` → `[]`, 0 runnable items; the selector prints "nothing matched".
- `since` values across `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`: `v15` 51 · `v16` 141 · `v17` 55 · `v18` 0.
- Main publishes `18.0.0-next.2` (`packages/spec/package.json`; `.changeset/pre.json` is `mode: pre`, tag `next`); `.changeset/pre/` holds 714 consumed changesets; npm `latest` is `17.7.0`.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` § "How a release sweep works" defines the sweep for `vN` as `since == vN` ∪ all `P0` ∪ items whose `source` cites a PR in the release. For v18 the first leg is empty, so a sweep today re-runs the 19 P0 smoke items and nothing the v18 line added.

## Done when

1. Every user-reachable capability the v18 line added or changed has a ledger item with `since: "v18"`, or one line in the PR saying why none is authorable (a pure retirement already pinned by a test is the common case — cite the pin). Starting points: the `18.0.0-next.*` entries of `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md`, the consumed changesets under `.changeset/pre/`, the ADR-0087 step-18 registries, and the ADR-0131 stages.
2. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` passes on the PR head.
3. One `checklist-test since:v18` run against the authored items, its `qa-run` record filed per `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §4, each product defect extracted to its own card per §5 and linked here.

## Not this card

- Running the existing 272 items: #23878, filed in the same batch. That card makes no ledger edits, so the two share no file.
- Fixing what the run finds: each defect gets its own extracted card.

## Dedupe

None covers v18.
